'''Sils Naffiff''' was the very wealthy head of [[Naffiff Brothers]], a construction company hired to renovate the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]. He stole the [[Insignia of Unity]] and replaced it with a fake early in the process.
